title: Developer Tools on Craftisle — Formatters, Encryption, Converters & More
description: 28 free developer tools for everyday coding. JSON/SQL/YAML formatters, AES/bcrypt encryption, Base64 conversion, regex testing, JWT decoding, Cron expressions, and QR generation.

body.raw:
Every developer needs a toolkit of reliable utilities they can reach for without friction. Craftisle's developer tools provide exactly that — **28 free, browser-based tools** covering encryption, formatting, conversion, testing, and generation. No installs, no accounts, no limits.

## Encryption & Hashing (4 tools)

### AES/DES Encrypt
Full symmetric encryption with support for AES and DES algorithms. Choose between ECB and CBC modes with 128/192/256-bit keys. Encrypt and decrypt text or files entirely in your browser.

**Use case:** Encrypt configuration values, API keys, or sensitive data before storage.

### Bcrypt Hash
Industry-standard password hashing with adjustable cost factor. Generate bcrypt hashes for authentication systems. Verify passwords against existing hashes.

**Use case:** Hash passwords during development or generate test data for auth systems.

### Hash Tool
Compute MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, and RIPEMD-160 hashes. File hashing with drag-and-drop support. Verify file integrity or generate checksums.

**Use case:** Verify downloaded file integrity or generate content hashes.

### JWT Decoder
Decode JSON Web Tokens to inspect header, payload, and signature. View claims, expiration, and issuer information. Validate token structure.

**Use case:** Debug authentication issues or inspect API tokens during development.

## Formatters (5 tools)

### JSON Formatter
Beautify, minify, and validate JSON with tree view navigation. Collapsible nodes for large objects. Copy formatted output with one click. **Most popular tool on Craftisle.**

### HTML Formatter
Format HTML code with proper indentation. Supports JSX syntax. Minify option for production optimization.

### SQL Formatter
Format SQL queries with configurable keyword casing (UPPER/lower). Handles nested queries, CTEs, and complex joins.

### YAML Formatter
Validate and format YAML. Perfect for Kubernetes manifests, GitHub Actions workflows, and Docker Compose files.

### HTML Escape
Escape and unescape HTML special characters. Essential for preventing XSS vulnerabilities and encoding user-generated content.

## Converters (9 tools)

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **Base64 Encode/Decode** | Text and file encoding with instant preview |
| **Base32 Encode** | Base32 encoding for legacy systems |
| **Base58 Encode** | Bitcoin/IPFS-style encoding without ambiguous characters |
| **Radix Converter** | Convert between bases 2-36 with live preview |
| **CSV ↔ JSON** | Bidirectional conversion with custom delimiters |
| **URL Encode/Decode** | Percent-encoding for URLs and query parameters |
| **Image to Base64** | Embed images as data URIs for HTML/CSS |
| **PNG to SVG** | Raster to vector conversion via edge detection |
| **PDF Tools** | External link to [pdf.craftisle.com](https://pdf.craftisle.com) |

## Developer Tools (7 tools)

### Cron Expression Builder
Interactive cron expression editor with human-readable preview. See exactly when your cron job will run next. Supports standard 5-field cron syntax.

### Regex Tester
Real-time regular expression testing with match highlighting. View captured groups, match positions, and test against sample text.

### Regex Visualizer
**5-star rated tool.** Visualize regex patterns as interactive AST diagrams. Understand complex regex by seeing the parse tree and character classes visually.

### Mermaid Chart Editor
Create flowcharts, sequence diagrams, Gantt charts, class diagrams, and more using Mermaid syntax. Live preview with PNG/SVG export.

### SVG Editor
Write SVG code with real-time preview. Edit paths, shapes, and attributes with instant visual feedback.

### HTML Visual Editor
WYSIWYG HTML editor with live preview. Edit HTML and see the rendered output simultaneously.

### File Viewer
External link to [viewer.craftisle.com](https://viewer.craftisle.com) — preview 100+ file formats online.

## Generators (7 tools)

| Tool | Rating | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| **QR Code Generator** | ⭐5 | Customizable QR codes with logo support, color, and size options |
| **UUID Generator** | — | RFC-4122 compliant UUID v4 batch generation |
| **Lorem Ipsum** | — | Placeholder text generation with configurable paragraphs |
| **Random String** | — | Cryptographically secure random strings for passwords/API keys |
| **Random Group** | — | List randomization with seed-based reproducibility |
| **Pixel Art Generator** | — | Convert images to pixel art style |
| **Handwriting Animation** | ⭐5 | Convert text to animated handwriting SVG |

## Pro Tips

1. **Bookmark `/tools/json-formatter`** — It's the fastest JSON formatter you'll find. No page loads, no ads.
2. **Use Regex Visualizer for complex patterns** — Seeing the AST makes debugging regex 10× faster.
3. **QR Code Generator handles logos** — Add your brand logo to QR codes for better scan rates.
4. **Cron Builder shows "next run"** — Verify your cron schedule before deploying to production.
5. **All encryption is client-side** — Your keys and data never leave your browser.

## Integration with PDF Tools

For document-level operations, switch to our [PDF Tools](https://pdf.craftisle.com):
- Base64 encode PDF attachments → Image to Base64, then embed
- Generate QR codes for PDF document links → QR Code Generator
- Validate JSON configuration files for PDF processing → JSON Formatter

## Privacy & Security

Every encryption, hashing, and formatting operation runs entirely in your browser. No data is transmitted to any server. This means:

- Encrypted data is only visible to you
- Hashed passwords are computed locally
- Sensitive configuration files stay on your machine

Start using all tools at [craftisle.com/tools](/tools).

title: Craftisle Ecosystem — 135+ Free Online Tools in One Platform
description: Complete overview of the Craftisle tool ecosystem. Image editors, PDF processors, file viewers, resume builder, encryption, formatters, converters — all 100% browser-based, no signup required.

body.raw:
## What is Craftisle?

Craftisle is a comprehensive **free online tools platform** that brings together 135+ browser-based utilities across 4 specialized products. Every tool runs entirely in your browser — no data is ever uploaded to a server, no signup is required, and everything is free forever.

## The Four Products

### 1. Craftisle Main Site (craftisle.com)

The flagship platform hosts **62 built-in tools** across 10 categories:

| Category | Tool Count | Highlights |
|----------|-----------|------------|
| **Image** | 17 tools | Resize, crop, compress, convert, watermark, meme generator, favicon maker, beautify screenshots |
| **Encryption & Hashing** | 4 tools | AES/DES encrypt, bcrypt hash, SHA/MD5 hash, JWT decoder |
| **Formatters** | 5 tools | JSON, HTML, SQL, YAML formatter, HTML escape |
| **Converters** | 9 tools | Base64/32/58, CSV↔JSON, URL encode, image-to-base64, radix converter |
| **Developer Tools** | 7 tools | Cron expression builder, regex tester & visualizer, mermaid charts, SVG editor, HTML visual editor |
| **Generators** | 7 tools | QR code, UUID, lorem ipsum, random string, pixel art, handwriting animation |
| **Text Tools** | 4 tools | Case converter, diff checker, unicode lookup, text formatter |
| **Network Tools** | 3 tools | IP calculator & radix converter, user-agent parser |
| **Utilities** | 7 tools | Pomodoro timer, countdown, stopwatch, coin flip, wheel spinner, scoreboard |

title: Complete Guide to Craftisle Image Tools — 17 Free Online Image Editors
description: Master all 17 Craftisle image tools. Resize, crop, compress, convert formats, add watermarks, generate memes, create pixel art, and more — all in your browser with zero uploads.

body.raw:
Craftisle's image tool suite is one of the most comprehensive collections of **free online image editors** available. Every tool runs entirely in your browser using WebAssembly and modern Canvas APIs — no files are ever uploaded to a server.

## All 17 Image Tools

### 1. Image Resizer
Resize images by exact dimensions or percentage. Supports width, height, and fit modes (cover, contain, fill). Perfect for preparing images for web, social media, or print.

### 2. Image Cropper
Interactive crop tool with precise pixel-level control. Drag to select your crop area and export in any format. Built on react-image-crop for smooth interactions.

### 3. Image Compressor
Reduce file size while maintaining quality. Adjustable compression levels with real-time preview. Supports JPEG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF output formats.

### 4. Image Converter
Convert between image formats instantly. Supported formats: **JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, BMP**. Batch conversion support with quality control.

### 5. Image Rotator
Rotate images by any angle — not just 90° increments. Flip horizontally or vertically. Real-time preview before export.

### 6. Color Palette Extractor
Extract the dominant color palette from any image. Returns hex codes and color distribution data. Great for brand color extraction and design inspiration.

### 7. Favicon Generator
Generate favicon sets from any image. Creates multiple sizes (16×16, 32×32, 48×48, 64×64, 128×128, 256×256) plus Apple touch icons. Perfect for websites and PWA manifest.

### 8. Strip Metadata
Remove EXIF, GPS, camera info, and other metadata from images. Essential for privacy before sharing photos online. Batch processing supported.

### 9. Image Info
View detailed image properties — dimensions, format, file size, color depth, metadata, and EXIF data. Quick inspection without opening an image editor.

### 10. Image Border
Add customizable borders to images. Control border width, color, and style. Perfect for framing photos or creating consistent image styling.

### 11. Watermark
Add text watermarks to protect your images. Customize font, size, color, opacity, and position. Ideal for photographers and content creators.

### 12. Color Adjust
Fine-tune brightness, contrast, saturation, and hue. Real-time preview with sliders for each parameter. Non-destructive editing.

### 13. Passport Photo Generator
Create passport and visa photos that meet official requirements. Automatic face detection, background removal, and size compliance for multiple countries.

### 14. Meme Generator
Create custom memes with top and bottom text. Classic meme formatting with font controls. Add your own images or use templates.

### 15. Beautify Screenshots
Transform plain screenshots into polished marketing images. Add shadows, rounded corners, backgrounds, and padding. Perfect for documentation and social media.

### 16. Find Duplicates
Detect duplicate or near-duplicate images using perceptual hashing (pHash). Compare image content regardless of resolution or minor edits. Batch scan entire folders.

### 17. Create GIF
Combine multiple images into animated GIFs. Control frame delay, loop count, and output quality. Create simple animations without specialized software.

## Image Tools vs PDF Tools

While Craftisle Image Tools handle raster and vector image operations, for document-level image tasks you may want to use our [PDF Tools](https://pdf.craftisle.com):

| Need | Use |
|------|-----|
| Edit a single image | Image Tools |
| Convert images to PDF | PDF Tools → JPG/PNG to PDF |
| Extract images from PDF | PDF Tools → Extract Images |
| Watermark PDF pages | PDF Tools → Add Watermark |
| Compress scanned documents | PDF Tools → Compress PDF |

## Tips for Best Results

1. **Use WebP for web** — WebP offers 25-35% smaller files than JPEG at the same quality
2. **Strip metadata before sharing** — Remove GPS coordinates and camera info for privacy
3. **Compress before uploading** — Reduce file size before uploading to websites or social media
4. **Convert to AVIF for next-gen web** — AVIF provides even better compression than WebP
5. **Use perceptual hashing for dedup** — Find duplicates even when images have been resized or lightly edited

## All Tools Work Offline

Since all processing happens in your browser, Craftisle Image Tools continue to work even without an internet connection after the initial page load. This makes them ideal for:
- Working on sensitive documents
- Editing images while traveling
- Processing files in secure environments

Visit [craftisle.com/tools?category=image](/tools?category=image) to start using all image tools now.

title: PDF & File Tools on Craftisle — 67 PDF Utilities + 100 Format Viewer
description: Complete guide to Craftisle PDF Tools and File Viewer. Merge, split, compress, OCR, sign, convert 20+ formats, and preview 100+ file types — all in your browser with zero uploads.

body.raw:
Craftisle's PDF and file handling capabilities are split across two specialized subdomains: **pdf.craftisle.com** (67 PDF tools) and **viewer.craftisle.com** (100+ format viewer). Together they cover virtually every document workflow you'll encounter.

## PDF Tools (pdf.craftisle.com)

All 67 PDF tools run on **WebAssembly** via pdf-lib and qpdf.wasm — meaning your documents are processed entirely in your browser. No file uploads, no server processing, no privacy concerns.

### Organize & Manage (24 tools)

**Core Operations:**
- **PDF Multi-Tool** — All-in-one merge, split, organize, rotate, extract, and delete pages
- **Merge PDF** — Combine up to 100 PDFs with drag-and-drop reordering
- **Split PDF** — Split by page ranges or extract individual pages
- **Extract Pages** — Select specific pages with preview thumbnails
- **Organize PDF** — Rearrange, duplicate, and delete pages with visual grid
- **Delete Pages** — Remove unwanted pages with multi-select

**Advanced Operations:**
- **OCR PDF** — Optical character recognition for scanned documents (multi-language)
- **Alternate Merge** — Interleave pages from two PDFs
- **Add/Extract/Edit Attachments** — Embed and manage file attachments
- **Divide Pages** — Split each page horizontally or vertically
- **Rotate Custom** — Rotate by any angle, not just 90° increments
- **Overlay PDF** — Layer one PDF on top of another
- **N-Up Layout** — Print multiple pages per sheet (2-up, 4-up, 6-up, 9-up)
- **Grid Combine** — Arrange multiple PDFs in a custom grid layout
- **Booklet Maker** — Create print-ready booklets with saddle stitch

**Utility:**
- **Add Page Labels** — Roman numerals, prefixes, custom ranges
- **View/Edit Metadata** — Title, author, subject, keywords
- **Posterize PDF** — Split large pages into printable tiles
- **Compare PDFs** — Side-by-side or overlay comparison with diff highlighting

### Edit & Annotate (16 tools)

- **Edit PDF** — Full annotation suite: highlight, underline, strikethrough, shapes, freehand, images, search
- **Sign PDF** — Draw, type, or upload signatures. Multiple signatures per document
- **Crop PDF** — Trim margins across all or selected pages
- **Bookmark Editor** — Add, edit, import, and export PDF bookmarks
- **Table of Contents** — Generate TOC from bookmarks with custom styling
- **Page Numbers** — Add page numbers with custom position, format, and start number
- **Watermark** — Text or image watermarks with opacity, rotation, and position control
- **Header/Footer** — Custom headers and footers with text, dates, and page numbers
- **Form Filler** — Fill PDF forms with XFA support. Save and flatten after filling
- **Form Creator** — Create fillable forms with text fields, checkboxes, and dropdowns
- **Remove Annotations** — Clean up commented PDFs
- **Remove Blank Pages** — Auto-detect and delete empty pages

### Format Conversion (31 tools)

**To PDF (18 input formats):**
JPG, PNG, WebP, SVG, BMP, HEIC, TIFF, Word (DOCX/DOC), Excel (XLSX/XLS), PowerPoint (PPTX/PPT), XPS, RTF, EPUB, MOBI, DjVu, FB2, Markdown, Email (EML/MSG), CBZ

**From PDF (13 output formats):**
JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, TIFF, SVG, Word (DOCX), Excel (XLSX), PowerPoint (PPTX), JSON, Markdown, CBZ, Greyscale PDF

**Special:**
- **Extract Images** — Export all images from a PDF as ZIP
- **Extract Tables** — Extract tabular data to JSON, Markdown, or CSV
- **AI PDF Reflower** — Intelligent reflow for mobile reading with layout recognition
- **Vector Extractor** — Extract vector graphics as SVG

### Optimize & Repair (10 tools)

- **Compress PDF** — Reduce file size with image optimization and metadata removal
- **Fix Page Size** — Standardize to A4, Letter, Legal, or custom dimensions
- **Linearize PDF** — Optimize for fast web viewing (byte-serving)
- **Repair PDF** — Fix corrupted files and recover data
- **Deskew PDF** — Auto-straighten scanned documents
- **PDF to PDF/A** — Convert to archive-standard PDF/A-1b, 2b, or 3b with font embedding
- **Font to Outline** — Convert all text to vector paths for guaranteed rendering
- **OCG Layer Manager** — View, toggle, add, and delete optional content layers
- **Deep Sanitize** — Remove all metadata, incremental updates, and hidden watermarks

### Security (9 tools)

- **Encrypt PDF** — Password protection with AES encryption and permission controls
- **Decrypt PDF** — Remove password protection (if you have the password)
- **Sanitize PDF** — Strip metadata, annotations, scripts, and attachments
- **Find and Redact** — Search and permanently remove sensitive text
- **Flatten PDF** — Make annotations and form fields permanent
- **Change Permissions** — Set printing, copying, and editing restrictions
- **Digital Sign** — X.509 certificate signing (PFX/P12/PEM) with visible signature
- **Validate Signature** — Verify digital signatures and certificate chains
- **Timestamp PDF** — RFC 3161 trusted timestamping for audit trails

---

## File Viewer (viewer.craftisle.com)

Preview **100+ file formats** directly in your browser. Five specialized viewers for different content types.

### PDF Viewer
Full-featured PDF reader with page navigation, zoom (25%-500%), rotation, search, fullscreen mode, and direct download. Renders complex documents with vector graphics and embedded fonts.

### DOCX Viewer
View Word documents with preserved formatting — headers, lists, tables, images, and text styling. No Microsoft Office installation needed.

### XLSX Viewer
Preview Excel spreadsheets with formula evaluation, multiple sheets, merged cells, and conditional formatting. Read-only view for quick data inspection.

### PPTX Viewer
View PowerPoint presentations with slide navigation, animations, speaker notes, and fullscreen presentation mode.

### 3D & CAD Viewer
Interactive 3D model viewing with orbit, pan, and zoom controls. Supported formats:
- **STL, OBJ, PLY** — Standard 3D mesh formats
- **GLTF, GLB** — Modern glTF 2.0 with PBR materials
- **3MF, AMF** — 3D printing formats
- **DWG, DXF** — AutoCAD and CAD exchange formats
- **DAE, FBX** — Collada and Autodesk formats

### Image & Code Viewer
- **Images:** PNG, JPG, GIF, SVG, WebP, BMP, ICO, PSD, AI
- **Code:** JSON, XML, YAML, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python
- **Data:** CSV, TSV

---

## Why Client-Side Processing Matters

**Privacy:** Your documents never leave your device. Perfect for:
- Legal documents and contracts
- Financial statements and tax records
- Medical records and personal information
- Proprietary business documents

**Speed:** No upload/download waiting time. Processing starts instantly.

**No Limits:** No file size caps, no daily quotas, no usage limits. Process as many files as you need.

**Offline Capable:** PDF tools and file viewer continue working without internet after initial page load.

---

## Workflow Examples

### Compress and Share a PDF
1. Open [PDF Compress](https://pdf.craftisle.com/compress-pdf)
2. Upload your PDF (up to 100 files)
3. Adjust compression level
4. Download the optimized file

### Merge Multiple PDFs
1. Open [Merge PDF](https://pdf.craftisle.com/merge-pdf)
2. Drag and drop files in desired order
3. Click Merge
4. Download combined PDF

### Preview a CAD File
1. Open [viewer.craftisle.com](https://viewer.craftisle.com)
2. Upload your DWG/DXF/STL file
3. Rotate, zoom, and inspect the model
4. No CAD software needed

---

Start exploring: [PDF Tools](https://pdf.craftisle.com) | [File Viewer](https://viewer.craftisle.com)
